people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: Berechiah
people.line: Levite musician and gatekeeper in David's time

people.name: Shimea
people.line: Levite singer appointed by David for temple worship.

translations.web: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
